title: eucalyptus incrassata var. angulosa
intro: Eucalyptus incrassata var. angulosa, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Scribbly Gum, is a plant species native to Australia. It is valued for its essential oils, which have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Eucalyptus incrassata var. angulosa include decongestant, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and aromatherapy. Bioactive constituents of this plant include eucalyptol, limonene, and pinene, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
